# Anatomy of a Skill {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

In plain language

## A Saved Recipe Card {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="anatomy" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
A **recipe card filed in the office.** You say "make the quarterly summary" and the agent
pulls the card and follows it — you don't re-explain the steps.
:::

. . .

A Skill is just three things:

::: {.incremental}
- **A name** — what you call it
- **When to use it** — so the agent knows when to reach for it
- **The steps** — the recipe, in plain language
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## No code
You **describe the steps**. That's a "script" — Session 2's recipe card, saved.
:::

# Instructor Demo {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

"The Executive Briefer"

## What We're Building {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="briefer" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
**"The Executive Briefer"**
:::

. . .

Paste **raw, messy notes** → get a **board-ready decision memo**. Save it once as a
Skill — then run it on any future crisis.

## Step 1: The Recipe {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="recipe" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.8em;"}
**Name:** Executive Briefer

**When to use:** Any time I paste messy updates that leadership needs as a decision.

**Steps / rules:**

1. **Tone:** Direct, solution-oriented, "Private Sector Fast"
2. **Format:** Subject → **BLUF** (Bottom Line Up Front) → Problem & Options → Recommendation
3. **Language:** Professional English, focused on business impact
:::

## Step 2: Run It on a New Scenario {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="recipe" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 0.6em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.7em; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
Skill saved — now paste a **completely different** crisis to prove it remembers:
:::

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.8em;"}
"Creative agency called. Main video file is corrupted. Can't re-export until tomorrow. Paid ads go live at midnight! If we miss it, we lose the 'first day of Ramadan' spike. We can run a static image, but conversion is 50% lower. What do you want to do? Need answer now."
:::

## The Output {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.85em;"}

**Subject:** Ramadan Promo Launch — **CRITICAL ISSUE**

**BLUF:**
Main video asset corrupted; recommend launching static image to save the midnight slot.

**The Problem:**
Agency delayed. Missing midnight risks 100% of 'Day 1' traffic.

**The Options:**

- **Option A:** Delay (miss traffic, high quality)
- **Option B:** Static image (hit traffic, lower conversion)

**Recommendation:**
**Option B.** Presence is critical. Swap the video tomorrow.
:::

## What Just Happened {auto-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- We pasted **raw notes only** — no Role, no rules, no format
- The Skill already knew the recipe
- Board-ready memo in **10 seconds**
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-important}
## The point
Write the recipe **once**. Run the Skill **forever**.
:::

# Build: From Your Backlog {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Package a recurring task

## Make One Skill {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Hands-on
1. Pick one **recurring** task from your Automation Backlog.
2. Package it as a **Skill** (name, when-to-use, steps).
3. Run it **twice** — on two different inputs — to prove it generalizes.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Log the **recurring weekly saving** — this one repeats every week.
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Skill = a saved recipe card** the agent runs on command
2. **Anatomy** — a name, when to use it, the steps (plain language, no code)
3. **Write once, run forever** — a one-time delegation becomes a permanent capability
4. **Prove it generalizes** — run the Skill on a different input
5. **Don't over-engineer** — Skills for recurring tasks, chat for true one-offs
:::
